subject: Request for spot-check onboarding & offboarding evidence (Brightlane SOC 2)
messages:
From: Dana Morales <security@brightlane.io>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 5 Oct 2025 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Request for onboarding & offboarding evidence (SOC 2 spot check)

Hi Soojin,

We're executing a routine SOC 2 spot check for Brightlane's contract with Redwood (reference BR-8702). Can you please provide the following artifacts for employees in scope (engineering, product, and infra contractors) covering hires and leavers from 2025-07-01 to 2025-10-01: 

- Training completion records (security awareness + data handling) with completion dates and training IDs;
- Background check confirmation for new hires (redacted PII is fine) with dates and vendor reference;
- Joiner/leaver deprovisioning logs (IdP account disable times, last sign-in, access removal tickets);
- A short statement confirming process ownership for onboarding/offboarding and who approves access.

We're hoping to receive these by 2025-10-10 to keep the audit on schedule. If any items are sensitive, a redacted PDF or secure link is acceptable — please note retention controls for HR records.

If easier, we can take a consolidated bundle (zip) via a secure transfer link. Let me know the expected delivery and whom we should expect the package from.

Thanks,
Dana Morales
Security Assurance
Brightlane Health

Portal: https://portal.brightlane.io/requests/BR-8702
